story_title: A Legal Aid Interview in India
task_instruction: Rewrite each direct statement as reported speech.
paragraphs: Journalist Ananya visits a legal-aid clinic in an Indian district to write about support available during court proceedings in a fictional case. Lawyer Meera Rao explains her role. {{red:"I work with people who need help understanding legal documents."}} {{mask_1}} She describes the clinic's current work. {{red:"We are helping a client prepare for a hearing this week."}} {{mask_2}} The client, referred to by the pseudonym Nila, speaks about support she has received. {{red:"I have met with a counselor twice."}} {{mask_3}} Meera explains how the case file was organized. {{red:"The investigator recorded Nila's statement last Tuesday."}} {{mask_4}}

Counselor Farah talks about how she first heard from Nila. {{red:"I was waiting at the clinic when Nila called."}} {{mask_5}} Interpreter Dev describes his experience. {{red:"I have been translating court documents since 2021."}} {{mask_6}} Meera reviews the schedule. {{red:"The hearing will begin at ten tomorrow."}} {{mask_7}} Investigator Arjun explains how a record was located. {{red:"We found the original call log in this office yesterday."}} {{mask_8}}

Ananya asks about the steps before the hearing. Meera says, {{red:"The magistrate is reviewing the application now."}} {{mask_9}} She explains what she can do for Nila. {{red:"I can explain each step before the hearing."}} {{mask_10}} Farah describes Nila's choices. {{red:"She may decide whether to provide additional evidence."}} {{mask_11}} Meera emphasizes privacy. {{red:"Our team must keep her address confidential."}} {{mask_12}}

Farah describes a conversation at the clinic. {{red:"Nila was speaking with me when her advocate arrived."}} {{mask_13}} She explains what happened after the meeting. {{red:"I gave her a list of support services after our meeting."}} {{mask_14}} Meera describes the clinic's approach to privacy. {{red:"We have not discussed the case outside the legal team."}} {{mask_15}} Dev explains a translation decision. {{red:"I changed this phrase because the original wording was unclear."}} {{mask_16}}

Ananya completes her interviews and writes her article the following morning. Meera describes a document she plans to submit. {{red:"I will file the translated affidavit next week."}} {{mask_17}} Nila speaks about her daily routine. {{red:"I am studying for my exams while the case continues."}} {{mask_18}} Farah describes a step completed before a phone change. {{red:"I had saved copies of every notice before I changed phones."}} {{mask_19}} Finally, Meera updates Ananya about the schedule. {{red:"We have scheduled the next hearing for next month."}} {{mask_20}} The article focuses on legal vocabulary, confidentiality, and access to support without identifying the people involved.
